headline: Sensex and Nifty trade higher amid volatility; Hero Motors and Whirlpool rally while Ola Electric and OFSS tumble

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Balrampur Chini Mills received a Rs 75 crore BioE3 grant from the government
Blue Cloud's US arm secured a contract from IBM Cloud
Oracle issued a 'force majeure' notice to OFSS for a data centre project
High oil prices and yields are weighing on market sentiment despite IT offsets
whatHappening: Sensex and Nifty are trading in the green, with Nifty holding above the 23,000 level
Hero Motors shares hit a 20% upper circuit, marking a 73% rally in three days since debut
Whirlpool shares surged 9% while Ola Electric shares dropped 9% in morning trade
Realty and auto sectors are showing gains while the IT sector faces a broader pullback
summary: Indian markets opened higher with the Nifty trading above 23,000, supported by gains in realty and auto sectors. Hero Motors continued its stellar debut run with a 20% upper circuit, while OFSS and Ola Electric faced significant selling pressure. Investors remain cautious due to global headwinds like high oil prices and rising yields despite the domestic recovery.
